test_title: PYST 1: SSC Stenographer - Reasoning (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 1 )
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fa4c2369cfe8a4e66a235dba67f6b7d133f34cf28316421a8b17e917064f2d3e.png]
solution:
The pattern followed here is as follows:

⇒ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/774466e72521661db087cbd5f799e78bec4014eaf8054d815a0b3a08705a0712.png] is moving in clockwise direction by one place.

⇒ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3ed9492c685591eb4fdbf5c70859a9ebda00b6a78406adc97610c1a9ed0a8fa4.png] is moving from left to right in the series and then following the reverse order.

⇒ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/67a56903e697485e931814cae636deefa23ebf3454f83f76a99195a2d9c04a1f.png] is moving left to right in the series.

Thus, the figure series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6f07fa82263bb2900dbc12bfa1c98ac3bf0ca09975116947eb72dc955bbef0bf.png] 

Hence,** 'option 1'** is the correct answer.
